The '''Events Sack''' is an {{Epic}} [[Sacks|Sack]] that holds 20,160 Event related items each. It combines items from various events including the [[Carnival]], [[Fishing Festival]], [[Jacob's Farming Contest]], [[Mining Fiesta]], [[Mythological Ritual]], [[Season of Jerry]], [[Spooky Festival]], [[Starlyn Contest]]s, and [[Year of the Seal]].

== Trivia ==
*Despite being crafted from the {{Item|Winter Sack}} it doesn't hold all the items it can hold. It excludes the following items: {{Item|Enchanted Ice}}, {{Item|Enchanted Packed Ice}}, {{Item|Enchanted Snow Block}}, {{Item|Ice}}, {{Item|Packed Ice}}, {{Item|Snow Block}}.
